TextBlock.Text: THEATRE Timor corridor
DATE 2 November 2028 · 1410 local
SIDE Royal Australian Navy
WINDOW 55 min, closes at 82
F-35A — RAAF. Photo: U.S. Air Force photo by Senior Airman J. Michael Peña · Public domain · cropped
TIMOR CORRIDOR. A Chinese surface action group is working south-east down the corridor screening an amphibious transport, and it has begun turning merchant traffic back by radio and then by gun.

You send one ship, alone, sixty miles on their disengaged bow with the weather in your favour and a full deck-launcher load. The four merchants you are covering are ten miles behind you at a tug's speed, and ESCORT SEVEN, the Meridian boat that tried to stop Coral Pioneer on the eighteenth, is on their track to hold them for the surface group.

Establish the military threat, engage it, and be somewhere else when the counter-strike arrives - their JH-7A strike pair is within range of this box and their helicopter is already up. The merchants in the lane are not targets because somebody wrote SANCTIONED on a manifest.
Commodore Alex Mercer
COMMANDER'S INTENT

Your ship has the shot. The Sovremenny fired on a protected convoy in daylight, and that changes what you may do to her. The convoy behind you is what the shot is for; the Type 071 transport is not. If she turns north, let her. Come out with rounds left - there is no reload before Monday's convoy.
• Neutralise the Sovremenny screening the transport
• Lose no more than one merchant, and not Coral Pioneer
• Bring your ship out with anti-ship rounds left

One escort of your choice, with her anti-ship missiles and her flight. Opposing: a Sovremenny, a Type 071 with its Z-20J, a JH-7A pair, a Z-21 and Meridian Escort Seven. Four protected merchants behind you, two neutral ones ahead.

The planned window is 55 minutes. At that minute Command signals that you are behind schedule and holds the line for about 27 minutes more; the operation is closed at 82 minutes and the main task will be recorded as failed.
RULES OF ENGAGEMENT
All designated neutral contacts are protected. A protected neutral loss cancels the operation. Identify before you shoot.
